CustomField.label: Action Label
CustomField.description: Optional. The text for a read-only remediation link shown with the "Fix Message" on a failed check, e.g. "Open Account guidance". It renders as a link, not a button, and never updates records. Both "Action Label" and "Action URL" must be set for the link to appear.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. Link text shown with "Fix Message" on a failed check, e.g. "Open Account guidance". Read-only link (not a button). Set "Action URL" too.
